name: Keenable Web Search
description:
Keenable gives Claude live web access through two read-only tools:

- Web Search (search_web_pages): searches the Keenable web index and returns ranked results with title, URL, and snippet. Supports filtering by site and by publication or index date.
- Fetch Page Content (fetch_page_content): fetches any URL and returns its main content as clean markdown, so Claude can read a page it found via search.

Keyless by default: it works with no account or API key, rate-limited to 1,000 requests per hour. An optional Keenable API key lifts the rate limit and is never required to start. Built for agent workflows: search to discover sources, then fetch the most relevant pages to ground answers with citations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Keenable Web Search to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Keenable Web Search to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.keenable.ai/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Keenable Web Search MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Keenable Web Search scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Keenable Web Search MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Keenable Web Search provides these MCP tools: fetch_page_content and search_web_pages.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Keenable Web Search?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Keenable Web Search in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, PomoDial, and Soracom Knowledge.

_published_faq.name: Does Keenable Web Search MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Keenable Web Search does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Keenable Web Search is developed by Keenable. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
